violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SAUSAGE PATTIES AT 70F AND HASHBROWNS AT 61F IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP. FOODS WERE STACK ON TOP OF OTHER PREP CONTAINERS (NOT INSIDE THE PREP TOP PORTION OF THE COOLER).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS IN PREP-TOP ARE STORED IN THE PREP TOP PORTION OF THE COOLER (NOT STACKED).

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED COWAY WATER FILTER INSTALLED (WITHOUT APPROVAL). EHS WAS UNABLE TO DETERMINE IF IT IS NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS EQUIPMENT MAY NOT BE USED IF IT IS NOT NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT. PLEASE SEND SPECIFICATIONS TO THE EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Mechanical Ventilation System Capacity
violations.observation: Ventilation is not sufficient to keep rooms free of excessive vapors. OBSERVED FACILITY COOKING EGG PATTIES ON PORTABLE BURNERS THAT ARE NOT UNDER A HOOD SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide mechanical ventilation at a sufficient capacity to minimize soiling of walls, ceilings, and equipment; efficiently remove obnoxious odors and toxic fumes; and prevent the creation of hazards or nuisances involving the accumulation of fats, oils. PIC REMOVED EQUIPMENT AND DISCONTINUED COOKING EGG PATTIES THIS WAY DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOKING FOODS IS NOT PERMITTED THIS WAY AS IT IS NOT UNDER A HOOD SYSTEM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT CUPS AT 47F AND YOGURT DRINKS AT 48-50F IN DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF YOGURTS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOOD TEMPERATURES ARE MONITORED IF THEY ARE KEPT IN THE DISPLAY CASE.
